wire.skill_adoption.preview_required.role: Skill adoption CLI preview, confirmation, or keyed wire remedy
wire.skill_adoption.preview_required.tone: plain, calm, explicit about review and data preservation
wire.skill_adoption.preview_required.width: terminal prose; wraps without truncating commands or parameters
wire.skill_adoption.preview_required.note: Blocking unlinked same-name local folder. Both diffs compare the proposal against local and Hub guidance. Keep the skill ID, scope and options unchanged from preview through confirmation. Commands and flags are literal and untranslated; <receipt> is a CLI metavariable, not an ICU parameter.
